templates.name: ARTEX HTTP fingerprints (fixed targets)
templates.purpose: HTTP service discovery and built-in product fingerprints; no crawling.

templates.name: ARTEX IP TCP and HTTP inventory (top1000)
templates.purpose: Common TCP ports, protocol identification and HTTP storage for individually authorized IPs; not all ports. HTTP mapping is required to persist recognized HTTP services.

templates.name: ARTEX IP services and fingerprints (top1000)
templates.purpose: TCP inventory, protocol identification and HTTP fingerprints for explicit IPs.

templates.name: ARTEX Subdomains passive sources (manual)
templates.purpose: Gather names from public sources; external data requests and expanded names need authorization.

templates.name: ARTEX Subdomains DNS wordlist (manual)
templates.purpose: Active DNS wordlist enumeration; authorize the whole domain and DNS request volume.

templates.name: ARTEX Subdomains and takeover signals (manual)
templates.purpose: Collect subdomains and inspect takeover signals; does not claim accounts or register resources.

templates.name: ARTEX Web historical URLs (manual)
templates.purpose: Find historical URLs from public archives; history does not prove current exposure.

templates.name: ARTEX Web JS and API crawl (manual)
templates.purpose: Bounded-depth JS and URL collection; the crawler's domain scope is broader than a single host.

templates.name: ARTEX Web browser crawl (manual)
templates.purpose: Browser-driven request collection; review form submission and application side effects first.

templates.name: ARTEX Web sensitive data (manual, no verify)
templates.purpose: Inspect crawled response bodies for sensitive data; credential verification is explicitly disabled.

templates.name: ARTEX Web directory discovery (manual)
templates.purpose: Low-concurrency directory wordlist checks; intrusive enumeration requires separate approval.

templates.name: ARTEX Web backup discovery (manual)
templates.purpose: Time-bounded directory and backup-name checks; an alternative to SentryDir, not a duplicate pipeline.

templates.name: ARTEX Web JS monitoring baseline (manual)
templates.purpose: Record JS-body baselines from crawled URLs; this template does not create a recurring job.
